title.narrative: Operation and Maintenance of the Saudi Village for Yemeni Refugees in Abkhazia Governorate, Republic of Djibouti (Ninth Extension of the Operation and Maintenance Contract)

description.narrative: Operation and maintenance of project facilities, generators, pumps, and infrastructure networks including electricity, water, and sewage for the Saudi Village Project in Abkhazia Governorate, Republic of Djibouti.
Operation and maintenance of the Saudi village for Yemeni refugees in Abkhazia Governorate, Republic of Djibouti, which includes the operation and maintenance of all project facilities.
Providing a suitable environment to shelter the most vulnerable Yemeni refugee families in the camp and helping refugees access basic services.
